# @amykit/plugin-linear

Linear as the tracker, over its GraphQL API.

A plugin for [amy](https://github.com/nicolasmelo1/amy). It provides the `tracker` port and `tracker` in the `notify-channel` collection.

## Install

```sh
npm install -g @amykit/plugin-linear
```

Then name it in `~/.amy/config.yaml`:

```yaml
workflows:
  your-profile:
    plugins:
      - "@amykit/plugin-linear"
```

## Configuration

```yaml
plugins:
  "@amykit/plugin-linear":
    defaultRepo: ""
    endpoint: "https://api.linear.app/graphql"
    repoByTeam: {}
    workingStatusName: <string>
```

| Setting | Type | Required | Default | What it is |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `defaultRepo` | `string` | no | `""` | the repository used for a team that is not in repoByTeam |
| `endpoint` | `string` | no | `https://api.linear.app/graphql` | the GraphQL endpoint to talk to. Linear's own by default, and the one thing that has to move for a stand-in tracker to take its place in an end-to-end run |
| `repoByTeam` | `record` | no | `{}` | which repository a team's tickets land in, by team key |
| `workingStatusName` | `string` | **yes** |  | the exact status name a ticket must be in to be picked up |

Every field is checked at boot against the schema this package declares. A key that is
not one of the above is a refusal naming the plugin and the key, not a setting that
silently never applied.

## Environment

This package reads the following, which `amy doctor` checks for you:

| Variable |  |
| :-- | :-- |
| `LINEAR_API_KEY` | required at mount |
